balls.text: dropped by Dahiya!! It's his second drop of the day. It was a great delivery from Dubey, though. Dubey angled it across, and bowled a yorker just outside off. Ash was deep in the crease, and opened the face of the bat to guide the ball past the keeper. The ball went to Dahiya's right, and he went low to try and catch, but the ball popped out of his gloves
lack of pace, and beats Stubbs. DC pinch a bye, though. Full ball on off, and Stubbs has a hoick but misses. The batters rush for a run before the keeper throws the ball back

taken at mid-off!! Miller looks frustrated. It was there to be hit. A low full toss outside off, and Miller opens the face of the bat to only loft it as far as mid-off. On most days, you'd expect that ball to land beyond the boundary
another wide. Slower ball, but dull and extremely wide of off. Miller still looks to have a slash, but misses
very wide of off. Miller lets this go, even as it's a yorker-length ball
over wide long-off!! Miller launches this length delivery wide of off by reaching out, and pumps the ball deep into the stands for another six
good comeback. This is a yorker slightly wide of off, and Miller jams his bat down only for the ball to go back to Dubey off the bottom of the bat
flung away over deep square leg. A low full toss just outside off, and Miller gets low and across to swipe it for six from deep in the crease
lovely hit!! He was off balance but still successfully lofted this full ball around sixth stump to go over extra cover. There was the full face of the bat, and the ball flew over the boundary
extra bounce for Tyagi, and another dot. This is fired at 146kph. It is short and wide of off, and Ash looks to punch but misses
dot ball. He looks to reverse swat this short-of-a-length ball on off, but is beaten

this is called no-ball for height... and Rahane reviews again!! The third time in this over that the third umpire is involved. Ash was outside the crease when he looked to scoop, but eventually had to sway out of the way given it was a high full toss. I think the fact that he was batting outside the crease and seemed to squat while attempting the shot might go in KKR's favour. But we'll see. Oh, no! The ball is dipping, but still ends up over Ash's head. So this call stands

wow, how did that go over the keeper?! Tyagi bowled a yorker around seventh stump, and Ash reached out to squeeze it out. He got a bottom edge in the end, and the ball bounced just after hitting the bat. It ended up flying over the keeper

ohh, that looked tight. It's called wide, though... and this time Rahane reviews. The third umpire is involved back-to-back. Ash is deep in the crease, and looks to throw his bat at this full and wide ball outside off. The third umpire says some part of the ball is inside the wide line. So the decision is overturned. It's not a wide anymore

bowls a high-ish full toss on middle and leg. Miller heaves to midwicket and mistimes it. It's not given no-ball for height... and Miller reviews. The first side-on reply hints that the dipping ball may have arrived just on par with Miller's waist height. And the final replay confirms that the ball is actually below Miller's waist. So DC lose a review
but the over ends with a four. Dubey bowled this at just 118kph, but went with a bouncer just outside off. Ash waited for the ball to arrive, before ramping it over the keeper
great bowling. This is a yorker slightly wide of off. Miller can only drag it for a single to long-on
a knee-height full toss just outside off, and driven to deep cover point
slower delivery. Full and wide of off, and pushed to long-on
good fielding by Rahane. Miller went after this full and wide ball outside off, and found Rahane at point. The KKR captain slid to his left to prevent a run
angled in, and on a full length just outside off. Driven off the outside half of the bat to point
on a fullish length, and turning into the stumps. He goes back to clip to deep-backward square leg

taken at long-on!! A hint of the Rahul dismissal by Roy from early in the day. Like Roy, Varun goes slow and wide of off to tempt the batter. This one is full and wide, and turns away to finish even wider. Axar looks to swing down the ground, but finds Rinku at long-on. The ball went off the bottom of the bat there
to wide long-off. Axar slices this full and wide ball outside off aerially, and the bottom hand comes off the bat
almost a replay of the last ball. This is wide outside off too, although not so much. Axar keeps letting them go
ohh, that arrives four sets of stumps outside off. Varun bowls it full and really wide. Left alone by Axar
down the ground this time!! This ball is much flatter and quicker, and on the stumps. Axar lets this full ball come on, and launches it back over the bowler's head
nice turn. Very full, and angling across to arrive wide of off. Axar reaches out but misses
and the new bat works right away!! Six over square leg. This length ball dips just outside leg, and Axar lets it turn away, before slog sweeping for six
good second half of the over from Tyagi. He bowls this very full on off, and Axar drives to long-off
a man is out at a wide deep third, and Tyagi bowls a low full toss outside off. Miller drills it right to the fielder
Miller attempts the slash, but is beaten
bang!! I thought that didn't entirely come off the middle of the bat, though. But what do I know? Miller pulls this short ball from outside off, and dumps it over square leg
this is on a short of a length, and far quicker at 145kph. Axar swings it to deep midwicket
bowls a slower ball first up. Short in length around off, and shaping away to finish wide. Pulled to deep square leg
short in length again, and on the stumps. Swatted to long-off for another single
slightly fuller than the previous ball. But this pitches on leg again, and also hints to turn away. Swept to deep square leg
nicely bowled. This is much quicker than the previous balls this over. Short in length and outside leg, and turning away. Miller looks to pull but is hit high on his body
length ball on the stumps, and punched to long-off
sees Axar back away a bit too much, and follows him. Varun bowls this on a short of a length and outside leg. Axar ends up swiping to short fine leg
bowls it on the shorter side on leg, and Miller whips aerially to deep midwicket
well timed!! This time Axar skips down after making room, and slams this length ball on the stumps to deep extra cover. It looked risky, but you need that approach in T20s
Green digs it in short on off, and Miller pulls to deep midwicket
fuller side of a length on off. Miller punches even as the ball keeps low. On the bounce to point
a mistimed swat to deep cover. Axar looks to give it his all at this short-of-a-length ball around middle and off, but doesn't get it off the middle of the bat
fullish length on middle, and clipped to fine leg
on a fullish length on middle and leg. Axar looks to clip but is hit on his pad. The ball dribbles towards point
on the shorter side, and Roy is lucky to escape here. The ball is outside leg, and turning down further. Axar swipes it to fine leg for a single only
fuller side on middle, and clipped to deep midwicket

got him!! This ball is much slower and wide of off, and Rahul falls in the trap. Roy keeps bowling wide of off, but this time hardly offers any pace to work with. The ball is full and around seventh stump, and Rahul reaches out to have a swing at it. He can barely get it to long-on, though, as Powell moves forward to catch the ball
slapped to deep extra cover. If it has been short, it has either been wide or four this over. Yet another short delivery, and only a little wide of off. Rahul cuts it hard for another four
another wide outside off. Shorter side of a length, and way wide. Rahul leaves it alone
another short ball, and this is four. This is on the stumps, and Rahul transfers his weight back before pulling that flat and hard to deep midwicket
wide of off. Short of a length, and left alone by Rahul
fullish ball just outside leg, and turning in. Axar clips it to fine leg
yup, he does keep it below 40 off his four overs. A length ball just outside off, and punched to long-on after the ball turns away slightly
short delivery outside leg, and Rahul pulls to deep midwicket after getting his front leg out of the way
fuller ball, and on the stumps. Axar has to go back to dab to the off side for a hurried single
on a length around off, and turning away a bit. Pushed to cover after going back
Axar backs away early, and has to reach out to cut at this shortish ball just outside off. Two to deep point
angled across, and on the slightly shorter side just outside off. The ball turns away, and Rahul punches to long-off

hacked away to deep third. That was hit powerfully. Tyagi keeps bowling short, and although this isn't all that wide of off, Axar shifts his weight back to play the late cut as late and perfectly as possible

was that a top edge? Or did it go off the glove? I thought there was bat, else the ball may not have gone that far. Anyway, it's four. Short delivery climbing towards Axar's chest just outside leg, and he swivels to pull to fine leg
fifty off 25 balls!! Short in length, and wide-ish of off, as Rahul cuts that late to deep point. It was a slower ball as well, by the way
beautiful shot. Typical Rahul. He just lofts this length delivery through the line by slightly opening the face of the bat, and the ball sails over the long-off boundary

smashed!! Rahul crushes this short delivery around seventh stump for four to deep-backward point, where Green ends up running and diving to his left. He nearly saved a boundary, as he got hand before the ball went underneath him
ohh, direct hit may have been close!! Axar pushed at this length ball on off wide of mid-off, where Rahane rushed and threw at the bowler's end but slightly wide of the stumps
Short and wide outside off, Axar cuts to the right of Rinku at deep backward point who sprints and keeps them down to a run
Slower through the air on off, he defends
Oh, my word what a ball to get first up. Slower through the air just outside off, Axar isn't sure which way the ball is turning and pushes at it. Gets beaten
Floated gently to extra cover and Narine nabs Parakh. The ball sticks into the surface outside off, Parakh is early into his stroke and miscues it only as far as extra cover
Marginally short on off stump, he rocks back and pulls to deep midwicket
BANG! In the slot on off stump, turning away. Rahul steps forward, and with a clean swing of the bat thumps him over long-on
Ends the over by turning the length ball on off to deep midwicket
Very flat and quick outside off, he slaps this to deep backward point
Reverse-sweeps Varun for four more. Quicker length ball on middle, he bends down on one knee, goes reverse and lofts him over short third
Beaten on the cut again. Flatter outside off, turning away from Parakh, who backs away and eyes the cut, but the ball goes under his bat
Lifted up and over for four! Pushed quicker on a length outside off at 97.4kph, he clears his front leg and goes over extra cover
Darted outside off stump on the shorter side, he shapes up for a cut and misses
Loud appeal for lbw as Rahul is struck on the pad but the ball pitched outside leg. Flatter length ball on leg stump, he shaped up for the sweep and missed.
On a length at 90.9kph turning away from Parakh outside off, he cuts to sweeper cover
Length ball turning back into Rahul on middle and leg, he works this to deep midwicket
Oof, top shot! Flatter length ball going away from Rahul, who charges down the track and merely chips this straight over the bowler's head.
Juuust clears Green at long-on. Tossed up by Narine on off and middle, Rahul jumps down the track, doesn't get off the middle of the bat but generates enough power to clear long-on for a 77m six
Pushed quicker just around off stump, he plays with an angled bat to point
Goes a touch fuller now outside off, he prods forward and carves to deep point
Quicker outside off stump, Rahul goes right back and slams the cut to deep point
Back of a length ball outside off stump at 102.7kph, he stays back and cuts to deep backward point
Flatter outside off stump, he cuts to backward point
Darted on middle stump, he stays back and works this to deep backward square leg
Flatter length ball turning back into Rahul on leg stump, who defends
Dragged down and Parakh cashes in. Was on middle and leg, he hops back and lifts him over mid-on
Flatter outside off, he pushes to extra cover

Dropped by Rinku at backward point. Not a line, I've typed like ever. Parakh goes adventurous, a reverse sweep to Narine to a length ball on leg. Hits it straight to Rinku who gets both hands to and shells it. Was a sitter
Right in Parakh's wheelhouse and he goes straight as an arrow and all the way. Tossed up on middle, he gets under it and with a clean swing of the bat goes six
Slower through the air spinning away from Parakh, who gets a thickish outside edge to backward point
Tossed up on off stump turning back into Rahul, who eases to long-on
Good length ball angling away from Rahul outside off, he pats this to deep backward point

In the aiiiir and just short of Narine at mid-on. Slower offcutter bowled at 121kph just outside off. Rahul doesn't pick the slower ball and is through his drive early. Ends up mistiming it towards Narine, with the ball just dropping short
On a length on off stump, he opens the face of the bat and steers to deep backward point to get off the mark

A fine nick and Dahiya makes amends, taking a good low catch, diving forward. On a length angling away from Porel outside off stump. He pushes at it, only manages a thin edge and Dahiya does the rest. The umpire checks with the third umpire if the ball carried, all good. Porel walks back
Some extra bounce for Dubey. Back of a length ball outside off stump, he looks to cut that fine, but the ball continues to climb going over Porel's blade
Slower offcutter but that is past the tramline outside off stump as Porel shoulders arms, called a wide
On the fuller side of length just around off, he pushes to the left of Dubey who collects in his followthrough

Helped away and that is great fielding by Anukul. Length ball down leg, he picks it off his hips to the right of deep backward square leg where Anukul covers good ground, slides and keeps the batters down to one
Sharp good length ball outside off, he opens the face of the bat and steers past backward point
Driven for three. Fullish in length outside off, he drives on the up through covers

Edged and dropped! Oh that is a regulation chance for a keeper, but Dahiya has spilled it. Fuller swinging away from Porel outside off. He throws his hands again, gets a healthy edge to the left of Dahiya who makes a meal of it
Top shot. Full outside off, he presents the full face of the bat and drives on the up to the left of mid-off
Edged and the ball flies past slip for four. Fuller swinging away from Porel, who throws his bat at it, gets an edge but away from the fielder
Fuller in length on middle and leg, he turns it through square leg for a couple of runs
Oof, shot of the highest order from Rahul! Fuller angling away from him outside off, he goes inside-out over covers now for a one-bounce four

Picked up and deposited over deep backward square leg for the first six of the innings. Right in the slot for Rahul on middle and leg, easy pickings for him as he pings it off the middle of the bat and sends it away 71m
On a length on off stump, he pushes to backward point
Decks the length ball back into Porel on off and middle, he pushes to mid-on and sets off
Nasty short of a length ball to start with. Raps Rahul on the gloves even as he rose with the bounce. They pinch a quick run to the on-side
Short of a good length ball outside off nibbling away from Porel who cuts to backward point
Good length ball outside off stump, he stands tall and punches to backward point
Back of a length ball swinging away from Porel but well outside off stump. Called a wide
Beaten! Porel jumps down the track looking to go over mid-off. But the slight movement away from him outside off, does Porel in as he swings and misses
On a length on off stump, he chops this back onto the surface with the bowler collecting the ball in his followthrough
On a length on off stump with a hint of shape away from Rahul. He defends to the offside and sets off
On the fuller side of length outside off, he drives firmly but only as far as extra cover
Slower and fuller on leg stump, Rahul stays leg side of the ball and pushes to Green mid-on. They take a quick single
Flatter and shorter again just outside off, he slaps that not off the middle of the bat to the right of Green at mid-off who gives chase

Aerial but in the gap and Porel has two in two. Lovely, free-flowing drive from the opener. Tossed up from the front of the hand outside off, Porel leans forward and laces the gap between extra cover and mid-off
Dragged down again and this time, Porel cashes in. On leg stump, he rocks back and slams the pull to the right of deep backward square leg
On a length, slightly slower outside off, Porel punches to extra cover
Almost gets him first. Marginally dragged down and quicker on leg stump, he was early on the pull and inside-edges onto pad

got him!! Axar takes this at extra cover. DC win by 40 runs. Axar moved to his left after turning halfway. Ngidi had bowled a slower ball on a full length outside off. Varun went lofting, but couldn't get that away too far.
very full, slow and wide of off. Varun throws his bat at it, but is beaten
a yorker around off, and squeezed to midwicket. Varun doesn't run
Varun has some fun. Full toss on middle and off as the ball swings in, and Varun has a swing for four to fine leg

it does, and even takes the outside edge. But Porel is beaten, and there's no slip either. Dubey is squared up by this full ball angling in which straightens. He pushes forward and gets an edge. Porel dives to his right, but can't get a hand
a yorker, but slightly wide of off. Jammed down to point

sliced to mid-off. KKR lose three in the over. Starc angled it in, and fired one very full on the stumps at 142kph. Tyagi had his front leg out of the way, and went lofting by opening the face of the bat. But he toe-ended it to Axar at mid-off as KKR's slide continues
ohh, Varun is hobbling while running this single. He chips this full ball on off towards mid-on, and struggles to even run

Starc gets Roy!! He moves to his left, and waits for this skier to dip. This is on the shorter side of a length on off, and Roy went heaving across the line. But the extra bounce meant it took the higher part of the bat, and went straight back up. Easy take for Starc

direct hit at the bowler's end!! It's the sub fielder Rizvi at long-off. Starc bowled a full ball around off, and Roy drove that back hard and aerially towards long-off. Rizvi picked the ball up and threw it flat. Starc realised it was hitting the stumps and let it be, and it indeed struck to find Powell short
another perfect yorker, but this time Powell gets a thick inside edge. The ball swings in and arrives on middle. Powell has a heave, but gets it past the leg stump after swinging his bat early
lovely execution. Slow and full, and bang on a yorker length on middle. Roy can only squeeze it to point
full toss wide of off, and driven back to Ngidi with a flat bat

just over the man leaping at extra cover. It was Miller there. Roy chipped this slower ball which was full and wide of off, and nearly got dismissed. The ball went in the gap between long-off and deep cover point
great bowling. This is a yorker at 135kph. This lands bang on off, and Powell gets a bottom edge on to his boot before the ball deflects to the off side
full and slow, and just outside off. Pushed to deep cover point
pulled in the gap. Not a good ball to end his spell. He bowls it short on leg, and gets it to turn away. Powell thumps it to deep square leg
pushes this length ball to cover
short in length, and outside leg. Keeps low too, and Roy misses and so does the keeper as the ball turns down further. Deflected off the keeper to fine leg
full ball on the stumps, and pushed to deep square leg off the inside half of the bat
beaten outside off. Good ball. Very slow as well, at just 78kph. Full and just outside off, and turning away, as Powell looked to block
half an appeal for caught behind by Porel, but turned down. Full ball on leg and turning down further, as Powell looked to flick, but the ball took his pad
on a fullish length on leg, and turning away a touch. Powell shifts his weight back to nudge to deep-backward square leg
fuller ball, and tapped from outside off towards point for a rapid run
on a length outside off, and cut away to short third
much slower from Axar. On the shorter side of a length just outside off, and turning in. Clipped to fine leg
on a length, and just outside off. Punched to long-off
short of a length, and outside off. Punched down to long-off

bowled!! Dahiya can't capitalise on his drop. This ball keeps low, and smacks his middle and leg stumps. Axar angled it in and bowled short, and Dahiya went pulling from middle and off. But the ball also went on with the angle from around the wicket, and Dahiya got a bottom edge
on a length on off, and turning in. Defended to Kuldeep's right
short in length, and turning in. Slapped to deep cover point

dropped by Porel?! The reactions say so. Ohh, yeah. There's a feather of an outside edge. Kuldeep angled it in, and bowled full around sixth stump. The ball straightened and took the edge as Dahiya went to defend. It looked like Porel was in a hurry to celebrate there

wonderful catch by Stubbs!! Kuldeep on a hat-trick. My first impression was that the ball would fall well short of him at long-off. But Stubbs tip toes his way forward before going low and grabbing the ball barely off the ground. Rinku went inside out at this full ball which was dipping around off, but only managed to chip it aerially for a first-ball duck

taken at long-off!! Kuldeep strikes again. He saw Rahane make room, and followed him. The ball was tossed up, and dipped on a full length outside leg. Rahane went lofting down the ground, but ended up slicing it to Miller, who took it with a reverse cup
good shot, and good running. He lets this full ball dip on leg, and clips it aerially to go wide of long-on. Rahane then picks two in no time
length delivery around sixth stump, and pushed to long-on to keep ticking
wow, that's completely off track from Tiwari. He spots Rahane get across the stumps, and bowls a bouncer that seams in and ends up too high. Left alone by Rahane
shortish in length at just 111kph, and wide of off. Cut away to the point fielder's right
shorter side of a length, and just outside off. Swiped to long-on
ahh, extra bounce now. On a short of a length outside off, and catches Powell by surprise. Pushed towards long-off for a single
slower ball. On a short of a length, and wide of off. Slashed to point by reaching out
hooked over fine leg!! There's not much pace from Tiwari, and he bowls a bouncer just outside off. The ball rises over Powell's head, but he rolls his wrists to hook for six

this turns away from Rahane, who has to dive back in the crease to finish the second run. He clipped this full ball from outside off to long-on, and pushed for two. Porel whipped the bails off, but Rahane was in
good ball. This dips on a full length around middle and off, and turns in. Powell gets across to clip with the turn. Single to deep-backward square leg
dispatched to fine leg. The line is wrong from Kuldeep. He bowls this full and outside leg, and Powell goes down to slog sweep it hard
ohh, beaten!! Much slower from Kuldeep, who bowled the wrong 'un. It pitched just outside off and turned away, as Powell looked to heave across the line and missed
short of a length on off, and punched to long-off
chipped back down the ground. Kuldeep bowled it full and slow on middle, and Rahane pushed it back between him and the non-striker
on a full length, and just outside off. Punched to long-on again
on a length on middle and off, and pushed to wide long-on. There's a fumble down there, and it gives Rahane two. It's his fifty as well
full again, and just outside off. Driven to the man at extra cover
ohh, much slower now. This dips on a full length on off, and pushed back to Axar
this is flatter and quicker, and on a fullish length around middle and off. Punched to long-off
slow, and on a length on off. Pushed to long-on
Pushed quicker on off stump, he works this to deep backward square leg.

Kuldeep is down on the turf. Has he twisted his ankle? Oh, ouch! Think he has. Quicker outside off, Powell punches to long-off. Kuldeep after delivering the ball moved to his right, trying to get off the pitch. In doing that, he twisted his ankle. The physio runs out to tend to him

Straight down Miller's throat and Green's stay in the middle is a brief one. Tossed up outside off stump, Green looks to attack Kuldeep trying to go down the ground. He mistimes it completely and as far as long-off where Miller takes a comfortable catch
Pushed quicker on middle stump, he works this neatly to deep midwicket
Floated on the fuller side on off stump, he pushes to long-on
Tossed up on leg stump, he clips this aerially to deep midwicket
Fuller in length on off stump, he eases to long-on
Uses the width and steers this expertly. Slower fuller ball but the width was the key. Rahane waits for it and at the last moment, frees his arms and guides to the deep point fence
Fuller in length on off stump, Green is off the mark with a push to long-off

Has he taken that? Starc is claiming it! Wowza, that is a top, top catch by the fast bowler Slower and fullish in length outside off, Pandey skims this flat and low to the right of Starc at long-on. He sprints in, dives, gets both hands together and completes a stunner. The third umpire is called to check if Starc has taken that cleanly. Oh, he has.
Fuller outside off, he taps this to backward point
Almost deceives Pandey with the slower ball. Offcutter on off stump, Pandey has to check his bat swing and ends up defending to the offside
Flatter length ball on off and middle, he turns this in the gap between deep midwicket and long-on for a couple of runs
Oh, shot Rahane! Slower through the air but in the arc for Rahane on off, he backs away again and slams this straight down the ground over the bowler's head
Top shot! A round-armer from Axar but Rahane is up to the mark. Gives himself room and lofts him over long-off. Clean as!
Stifle appeal for lbw, but that was going down leg. Flatter on leg stump, he looks to flick that away but misses
Fuller on middle, Pandey works this to deep midwicket
WALLOP! Charges down the track to Axar, reaches the pitch of delivery and arrows it straight over the bowler's head
Slower back of a length ball on off, he pulls to deep midwicket
Flayed away for four. That's 4000 IPL runs for Pandey. Length ball on middle and leg, he gets across a touch and swipes that to the left of short fine leg
Slower and fuller well outside off stump, and past the tramline. Called a wide
Good fielding off his own bowling by Tiwari. Slower back of a length ball outside off, Pandey swipes that back towards Tiwari who leaps and saves atleast a run
On a length at 133.3kph just outside off, Pandey pats this to backward point where Ashutosh is quick onto the ball
Back of a length ball outside off, he carves that to deep point
Slower bouncer but way too short and  well down leg, Porel does well to collect that on the volley
Pace-off first up, was a slower offcutter at 113kph outside off which Pandey slices to deep point
Darted on off stump, he drives on the up firmly but only as far as extra cover
Flatter and fuller on middle and leg, he works this to midwicket
Fuller on off stump, he drives to wide long-off
Excellent riposte. Slows this down on off stump, Pandey is lulled into a false shot as he pushes to extra cover
Going, going, gone! Too full right in Pandey's arc on off stump, he gets under it and absolutely wallops it over wide long-on
Fuller on off stump, he drives to deep extra cover for a run
Crrrrunched! Length ball outside off stump, he lines him up and sends it aerially to the left of mid-on
Goes fuller again just outside off stump, he shovels that to mid-on
Lands the yorker on off stump which is jammed back to the bowler
On a length outside off stump, just inside the tramline as Pandey shoulders arms

CLEANS HIM UP! Ngidi into the wickets column very early. Cross-seam short of a good length ball outside off stump, decking back into Allen. He looks to swipe that across the line, gets a thick inside-edge with the ball making a mess of his stumps. Allen thumps his bat with his gloves and trudges off
Short of a good length ball on off stump, he punches to covers
Two in two! KKR are up and away. Length ball angling back into Rahane, who goes across the line and mows this over deep midwicket
WHACKED! This one's clean from Rahane. Length ball with the angle coming back into Rahane, who picks this up and deposits across the line over long-on
On a length on off stump, he works this to deep backward square leg with a bit of a flourish
Almost chops this back on. Length delivery spearing back sharply into Allen. He looks to push that through the offside, ends up getting a thick inside-edge onto pad
Neatly clipped. Length on Allen's pad, he nonchalantly works this to the right of mid-on for four
Length ball arching back into Allen on off stump at 136kph, he mistimes his drive to extra cover
An ugly swipe gets Rahane four. He will take 'em. Fuller in length angling away from Rahane outside off. He goes after it, gets a top-edge with the ball flying over short third
Rahane has chipped the bottom of his bat. Length around off stump, he gets it right off the cue end of the bat to mid-off. Calls for a new bat, right away
On a length closer to Allen's body on off stump, he taps that with soft hands to the offside and sets off
On a length with a hint of movement away from Allen who gets a thick outside edge to backward point
Steered fine for four. Starc goes fuller, angling away from Allen who opens the face of the bat and guides past short third
BANG! Length ball on off stump, he stays still, not a lot of foot movement and goes straight down the ground for a big 87m six. Such a clean swing of the blade from Allen
Leading edge flies over covers and Rahane gets two. On a length with the ball shaping away from Rahane, who wanted to play that to the on-side, instead gets it over Ashutosh at cover-point
Beaten on the inside-edge. Length ball decking back into Rahane, cuts him into half and just misses the offpole
Beaten! Good length ball shaping away from Rahane outside off, he charges down the track looking to go up and over. Doesn't connect

Goes high and gets four for his effort. A touch fuller nibbling away from Rahane outside off. He goes across the line, with a full swing of the bat. Doesn't get it anywhere in the middle of the blade, with the ball going straight up. But mid-on is in and the ball skips away for four
On a length on off stump, he gets right behind it and defends

Nabi is down on the ground losing his footing in his followthrough. But, he has delivered an excellent first ball. A length ball that is spearing back into Rahane on middle and leg, striking his pad. Porel wants Axar to review this. He has. I felt that was sliding down leg. Yep! Impact is umpire's call and the ball was sliding down leg

Smashed back firmly at Starc, with the ball not sticking. Harsh to call that a drop. Fullish in length decking back into Allen on off, he punches that aerially towards Starc, who can't quite get his hands together in time

Big appeal from the keeper, nothing from Starc and they don't review. Full, curling back into Allen just outside off stump. He fails to get bat down in time, with the ball sneaking under the bat and just missing off pole
And he is away. Rising back of a length ball outside off, he punches on the up to the left of mid-off to get off the mark in style
Off the mark with a quick run. On a length outside off stump, he punches to extra cover for a quick run
Goes fuller outside off stump, he jams to mid-off
Short of a length ball angling across Rahane, who shapes up for a cut and is beaten
